# The `mineworld` command

This reference describes the packs installed in this build of mineworld; a build with other packs generates a different one (`docs/DECISIONS.md` `ARC-90`). It is generated from the types that read each file, so it is never edited by hand.

Every subcommand and argument this build's `mineworld` accepts, from its own parser. `mineworld <command> --help` prints the same.

## `mineworld server`

Host a World Pack for clients

| Argument | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `<world>` | yes | — | The World Pack directory, such as worlds/social-cafe. |
| `--listen LISTEN` | no | `127.0.0.1:7878` | Where to listen; 0.0.0.0:7878 lets friends on a LAN reach it. |
| `--invite TOKEN` | no | — | The invite every client must present to join; else one is generated and printed once. Also read from `MINEWORLD_INVITE`. |
| `--admin-token ADMIN_TOKEN` | no | — | The bearer token that opens /admin (else none); never printed; not the invite. Also read from `MINEWORLD_ADMIN_TOKEN`. |
| `--agent SEAT` … | no | — | Drive that seat with the reactive rule controller whenever no player holds it; repeatable. |
| `--town` | no | `false` | Drive every other seat with the paced rule controller whenever no player holds it. |
| `--seed SEED` | no | `0` | The paced controllers' seed. |
| `--pace SECONDS` | no | `5` | How often each paced seat is consulted, in wall seconds (time scale never speeds it up) |
| `--hold SECONDS` | no | `30` | How long a dropped connection's seat is held for its resume, in wall seconds; 0: none. |
| `--time-scale N` | no | `1` | How many world seconds pass per wall second. |
| `--keyframe-every N` | no | `50` | Every Nth frame to a client is a whole observation; the others are deltas (DEP-15) |
| `--save DIR` | no | — | Keep the world in DIR/world.sqlite: created the first time, resumed where it stopped after. |
| `--decisions FILE` | no | — | A decision list to use instead of the pack's decisions.yaml. |
| `--seat-model SEAT=MODEL` … | no | — | Drive that seat with that installed decision model; repeatable. |
| `--packs DIR` … | no | — | A directory whose immediate subdirectories are packs, searched for the world's requires:. Repeat it for more; MINEWORLD_PACKS adds more after these. |

## `mineworld create`

Write a new, minimal World Pack into a directory that does not exist yet; its name becomes the world's id

| Argument | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `<directory>` | yes | — | The directory to create, such as worlds/my-town. |

## `mineworld inspect`

Say what a save holds, and check that every fact in it has a cause — without resuming or writing it

| Argument | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `<save>` | yes | — | The save directory (the one given to --save) |
| `--last LAST` | no | `20` | How many of the newest facts to list. |

## `mineworld run`

Run a World Pack headless — no renderer, no network, no model — every seat driven by a seeded rule, and print what happened

| Argument | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `<world>` | yes | — | The World Pack directory. |
| `--headless` | yes | `false` | Required: the only mode `run` has (MODULE_SPEC §8.1) |
| `--seed SEED` | yes | — | The controllers' seed. The same seed reproduces the run exactly. |
| `--days DAYS` | yes | — | The age to run the world to, in simulated days since its genesis. |
| `--save DIR` | no | — | Keep the world in DIR/world.sqlite; an existing save is resumed and run on to the same age, so re-running a killed command finishes the same world. |
| `--decisions FILE` | no | — | A decision list to use instead of the pack's decisions.yaml. |
| `--seat-model SEAT=MODEL` … | no | — | Drive that seat with that installed decision model; repeatable. |
| `--packs DIR` … | no | — | A directory whose immediate subdirectories are packs, searched for the world's requires:. Repeat it for more; MINEWORLD_PACKS adds more after these. |

## `mineworld perceived`

| Argument | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `<world>` | yes | — | The World Pack the save was created from (it names people by their keys) |
| `--save DIR` | yes | — | The save to read. |
| `--person KEY` | yes | — | The Person, by authoring key, such as alice. |
| `--since ID` | no | — | Only the facts after this event id: the cursor of the server's perceived stream. |

## `mineworld reference`

Write the configuration reference generated from this build's code — every field a World Pack's files may set — or check a directory against it (ARC-90). Loads no world

| Argument | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--out DIR` | no | — | Write the reference into DIR, creating it; refused when DIR holds a file it did not write. |
| `--check DIR` | no | — | Compare DIR with what this build generates; exit 1 naming each file that differs, is missing or is extra. |
